# Shark Tank Egypt Directory: full data (updated 2026-10-22)

One entry per startup that pitched on Shark Tank Egypt (شارك تانك مصر). Outcomes are recorded only when a public source states them; "unconfirmed" means no source has been found yet.

## Gutty (جاتي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/gutty/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/gutty/
Sector: Food
Outcome: unconfirmed
Gutty is announced for Season 5, episode 3. Rescheduled to Friday, 23 October 2026 at 9 PM Cairo time, after Egypt Forum coverage on 21 October. Watch on CBC Now and WATCH IT. Investment requests and deal outcomes have not been verified.
أُعلنت مشاركة جاتي في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ٣. تأجل عرض الحلقة إلى الجمعة 23 أكتوبر 2026، الساعة 9 مساءً بتوقيت القاهرة، بسبب تغطية منتدى مصر يوم 21 أكتوبر. تُعرض على CBC Now وWATCH IT. لم تُوثَّق طلبات الاستثمار أو نتائج الصفقات بعد.
Gutty prepares healthy meals in Cairo and offers monthly subscriptions. Customers choose their meals from the menu. The company has also advertised sugar-free options and Ramadan meal packages.
Sources: https://www.facebook.com/SharkTankEgypt/posts/pfbid02cPNKmaGTGCnD3kpqMofiW8wb2p8kqNyKKGBxdGBmASsoSp7xjTsv3U5oQpaR4A99l https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1092222536906190 https://www.facebook.com/SharkTankEgypt/posts/pfbid021NPTkZTiNZqHW3FQpCPs5vQG2ZYsueXjWurqwp3Ak1EmRCxKGWEtffj3KxV3JLfRl https://www.facebook.com/GuttyEg https://www.facebook.com/GuttyEg/posts/pfbid0d4o2RxdFqHEvyToEPdaWgJNSK2pEYhLM4nxyTng3MigFGBmCfxsNkytmjgrCtjfhl https://www.facebook.com/GuttyEg/posts/pfbid02T9UUM5nMkcyNw7adUfK5b2tTjWTdRcKwAyYphaEYLAAMfrvRjoqciPcPD9hJKeBPl

## Polygon EV (بوليجون إي في)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/polygon-ev/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/polygon-ev/
Sector: Tech
Outcome: unconfirmed
Polygon EV is announced for Season 5, episode 3. Rescheduled to Friday, 23 October 2026 at 9 PM Cairo time, after Egypt Forum coverage on 21 October. Watch on CBC Now and WATCH IT. Investment requests and deal outcomes have not been verified.
أُعلنت مشاركة بوليجون إي في في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ٣. تأجل عرض الحلقة إلى الجمعة 23 أكتوبر 2026، الساعة 9 مساءً بتوقيت القاهرة، بسبب تغطية منتدى مصر يوم 21 أكتوبر. تُعرض على CBC Now وWATCH IT. لم تُوثَّق طلبات الاستثمار أو نتائج الصفقات بعد.
Polygon EV is an electric vehicle charging company in New Cairo. Its Manta charger supplies up to 22 kW of AC power for homes and businesses. It can go on a wall or stand, indoors or outside. Drivers can use the PolygonEV app over Bluetooth to check charging and adjust the current. The company also provides charging solutions for residential communities, offices and fleets.
Sources: https://www.facebook.com/SharkTankEgypt/posts/pfbid02cPNKmaGTGCnD3kpqMofiW8wb2p8kqNyKKGBxdGBmASsoSp7xjTsv3U5oQpaR4A99l https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1092222553572855 https://www.facebook.com/SharkTankEgypt/posts/pfbid021NPTkZTiNZqHW3FQpCPs5vQG2ZYsueXjWurqwp3Ak1EmRCxKGWEtffj3KxV3JLfRl https://www.polygonev.com/ https://www.facebook.com/PolygonEV

## Sahahly (صححلي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/sahahly/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/sahahly/
Sector: Education
Outcome: unconfirmed
Sahahly is announced for Season 5, episode 3. Rescheduled to Friday, 23 October 2026 at 9 PM Cairo time, after Egypt Forum coverage on 21 October. Watch on CBC Now and WATCH IT. Investment requests and deal outcomes have not been verified.
أُعلنت مشاركة صححلي في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ٣. تأجل عرض الحلقة إلى الجمعة 23 أكتوبر 2026، الساعة 9 مساءً بتوقيت القاهرة، بسبب تغطية منتدى مصر يوم 21 أكتوبر. تُعرض على CBC Now وWATCH IT. لم تُوثَّق طلبات الاستثمار أو نتائج الصفقات بعد.
Sahahly supports IGCSE teachers and their assistant teams. Its student reports help parents understand how their child is progressing, beyond the grade alone. The platform has shared examples of this work with biology teacher Dr. Radwa.
Sources: https://www.facebook.com/SharkTankEgypt/posts/pfbid02cPNKmaGTGCnD3kpqMofiW8wb2p8kqNyKKGBxdGBmASsoSp7xjTsv3U5oQpaR4A99l https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1092222520239525 https://www.facebook.com/SharkTankEgypt/posts/pfbid021NPTkZTiNZqHW3FQpCPs5vQG2ZYsueXjWurqwp3Ak1EmRCxKGWEtffj3KxV3JLfRl https://www.facebook.com/Sahahlyy

## Aqar Exit (عقار إكزت)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/aqar-exit/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/aqar-exit/
Sector: Real Estate
Founders: Mahmoud Ammar
Outcome: deal
Aqar Exit pitched in Season 5, episode 2. The founders asked for 10M EGP for 5%, valuing the company at 200M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ayman Abbas: 10M EGP for 10%.
عرض فريق عقار إكزت مشروعه في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ٢. طلب المؤسسون ١٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ٢٠٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أيمن عباس بقيمة ١٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜.
Aqar Exit is an Egyptian platform for reselling property units and transferring purchase contracts. It connects owners who need to leave installment commitments with buyers seeking units under earlier contracts. Founder Mahmoud Ammar said the platform had listed about 8,000 units in its first 40 days; this is a count of listings, not completed sales.
Sources: https://www.youm7.com/7580188 https://thepropertystats.com/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83-%D8%A3%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B9%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D9%8A%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%B5-10-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A5%D9%83%D8%B2%D8%AA/ https://aqarexit.com/ https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aqarexit.app https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1089498903845220

## SolarSector (سولار سيكتور)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/solar-sector/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/solar-sector/
Sector: Environment
Founders: Mohamed Youssef, Osama Mohamed
Outcome: deal
SolarSector pitched in Season 5, episode 2. The founders asked for 1M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 10M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Mohamed Farouk: 2M EGP for 51%.
عرض فريق سولار سيكتور مشروعه في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ٢. طلب المؤسسون ١ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل ومحمد فاروق بقيمة ٢ مليون ج.م مقابل ٥١٪؜.
SolarSector is an Egyptian solar-energy platform founded by Mohamed Youssef and Osama Mohamed. Its app estimates a customer's equipment needs and installation cost from electricity use, connects customers with suppliers, and offers maintenance support. The founders said the company also runs an installation team and focuses strongly on agricultural customers.
Sources: https://www.youm7.com/7580274 https://www.youm7.com/7580277 https://solarsector.net/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/solarsector https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1089498763845234

## Godly Pride (جودلي برايد)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/godly-pride/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/godly-pride/
Sector: Beauty
Founders: Maryam Elleithy
Outcome: deal
Godly Pride pitched in Season 5, episode 2. The founders asked for 3M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 30M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk and Hala El-Kasem: 3M EGP for 25%.
عرض فريق جودلي برايد مشروعه في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ٢. طلب المؤسسون ٣ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٣٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق وهالة خالد القاسم بقيمة ٣ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜.
Godly Pride is an Egyptian beauty brand founded by Maryam Elleithy. It combines skincare and makeup in products such as facial cleansers and cosmetics. Maryam said the business sold 48,000 units and generated more than EGP 14 million in sales over three and a half years before its Shark Tank Egypt pitch.
Sources: https://www.youm7.com/7580279 https://scenenow.com/Styled/Dazzle-Like-a-Deity-With-Local-Skincare-Makeup-Brand-Godly-Pride https://godlypride.com/pages/about https://godlypride.com/ https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1089498787178565 https://www.facebook.com/reel/2192595078309669/

## Aftah Topic (افتح توبك)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/aftah-topic/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/aftah-topic/
Sector: Entertainment
Founders: Ali Ayman, Hassan Ayman
Outcome: deal
Aftah Topic pitched in Season 5, episode 1. The founders asked for 2M EGP for 15%, valuing the company at 13.3M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk and Abdallah Sallam: 2M EGP for 25%.
عرض فريق افتح توبك مشروعه في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ١. طلب المؤسسون ٢ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٣٫٣ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق وعبد الله سلام بقيمة ٢ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜.
Aftah Topic (Eftah Topic) is an Egyptian maker of party and board games, founded by brothers Ali and Hassan Ayman. Its games are built for get-togethers with friends and family: they give a group something to talk about and play together instead of scrolling on their phones. The brand started with a single game and has since grown its catalogue to six titles, which it sells to Egyptian players through its Instagram presence.
Sources: https://www.youm7.com/7571670 https://www.youm7.com/7571713 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/10/7/%D9%85%D8%A4%D8%B3%D8%B3%D8%A7-%C2%AB%D8%A7%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%83%C2%BB-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%87-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%84-15-%D9%81%D9%8A-%C2%AB%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83/7571670 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HzpB9MINqnc https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1082971247831319

## Connecto (كونكتو)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/connecto/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/connecto/
Sector: Other
Founders: Mahmoud Abu Harga
Outcome: deal
Connecto pitched in Season 5, episode 1. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 50M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil: 6M EGP for 20%.
عرض فريق كونكتو مشروعه في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ١. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٥٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل بقيمة ٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜.
Connecto is an Egyptian startup that helps merchants run their businesses by bringing inventory and sales management into one place. It is built for sellers who want an easier way to track their stock and keep an eye on their sales. Founder Mahmoud Abu Harga started the company after about five years at Amazon, drawing on his e-commerce experience there. When it pitched on Shark Tank Egypt, more than 1,400 sellers were already using the platform.
Sources: https://arabic.pressbee.net/show11036386.html https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/10/7/%C2%AB%D9%83%D9%88%D9%86%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%C2%BB-%D8%AA%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%B9-%D8%AD%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%83%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%85%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%86/7571719 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cjOIbCLcDKY https://www.facebook.com/connecto.business/ https://www.connecto-me.com/ https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1082971354497975

## Olympic Sports (أوليمبيك سبورتس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/olympic-sports/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/olympic-sports/
Sector: Sports
Founders: Ziad El-Bessiouny
Outcome: deal
Olympic Sports pitched in Season 5, episode 1. The founders asked for 36M EGP for 20%, valuing the company at 180M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk: 36M EGP for 30%.
عرض فريق أوليمبيك سبورتس مشروعه في الموسم ٥، الحلقة ١. طلب المؤسسون ٣٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٨٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق بقيمة ٣٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٣٠٪؜.
Olympic Sports is an Egyptian company that runs sports academies for children, giving young people a structured place to train and grow through sport. Founded by Ziad El-Bessiouny, it has already served more than 250,000 children, which makes it one of the larger youth sports operators to pitch on Shark Tank Egypt. The founder brought the business to the show in Season 5 to raise capital for further growth.
Sources: https://www.youm7.com/7571708 https://www.mobtada.com/culture/1657155 http://www.soutalomma.com/Article/1253742/%D9%85%D8%A4%D8%B3%D8%B3-%C2%AB%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%83-%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%AA%D8%B3%C2%BB-%D9%8A%D8%B7%D9%84%D8%A8-36-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%87-%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%84-20-%D9%85%D9%86 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/10/7/%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83-%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%83-%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B3%D9%8A%D9%88%D9%86%D9%8A-%C2%AB%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%83-%D8%B3%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%AA%D8%B3%C2%BB-%D8%AE%D8%AF%D9%85%D8%AA-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AB%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-250/7571708 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gmk_RJbiuu0 https://www.instagram.com/olympic.sports.eg/ https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61565885369216 https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=1082971224497988

## Callista (كاليستا)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/callista/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/callista/
Sector: Fashion
Outcome: deal
Callista pitched in Season 4, episode 19. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Ayman Abbas: 1M EGP for 25%.
عرض فريق كاليستا مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٩. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل وأيمن عباس بقيمة ١ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜.
Callista is an Egyptian women's clothing brand built around casual, comfortable everyday wear. It targets women who want relaxed, wearable pieces without paying premium prices, and it stands out for good-quality fabrics relative to its price point and for a varied range of designs. Its line spans everyday tops and dresses to colourful, flowy summer pieces such as beach cover-ups, and Cairo lifestyle guides have featured it among local brands. On Shark Tank Egypt, Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Ayman Abbas invested in it together.
Sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kQM0eLYZ5Tw https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SszSyqiQJNc https://cairo360.com/?p=1764141 https://www.namshi.com/kuwait-ar/callista/ https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=886044094190703

## Bokaah Home (بوكا هوم)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/boka-home/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/boka-home/
Sector: Fashion
Outcome: deal
Bokaah Home pitched in Season 4, episode 19. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk and Hend Sabry: 4M EGP for 40%.
عرض فريق بوكا هوم مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٩. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق وهند صبري بقيمة ٤ مليون ج.م مقابل ٤٠٪؜.
Bokaah Home is an Egyptian fashion brand for people who are tired of conventional clothing. Its pieces are designed to be worn both at home and when going out, so one outfit can be comfortable indoors and still presentable outside. The brand appeared in Season 4 of Shark Tank Egypt, where it was presented alongside Callista as one of two projects representing the fashion trends of 2026.
Sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GTX8Ces3VTs https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m8o-D7LTlQ4 https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=886044304190682

## OG Bees (أو جي بيز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/og-bees/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/og-bees/
Sector: Tech
Outcome: deal
OG Bees pitched in Season 4, episode 19. They walked away with a deal with Ayman Abbas: 5M EGP for 17.5%.
عرض فريق أو جي بيز مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٩. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أيمن عباس بقيمة ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٧٫٥٪؜.
OG Bees is an Egyptian platform for producing and managing user-generated content (UGC) for brands. Instead of relying only on big influencers or studio shoots, it turns everyday social-media users into paid content creators who make authentic posts and videos for brands. Brands get a steady flow of real, relatable content, while ordinary users get a way to earn from what they already do online. The startup pitched on Season 4 of Shark Tank Egypt, where several sharks competed for the deal. Ayman Abbas invested; the show listed it among his three strongest Season 4 investments.
Sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1NkHp237TY https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyEpncMRFAo https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MTBclNRzQEY https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1PAHQcDbZd8 https://ogbees.com/ https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/og-bees/ https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=886044180857361

## Lamarckii (لاماركي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/lamarckii/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/lamarckii/
Sector: Agriculture
Outcome: deal
Lamarckii pitched in Season 4, episode 18. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Ayman Abbas: 5M EGP for 35%.
عرض فريق لاماركي مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٨. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل وأيمن عباس بقيمة ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٣٥٪؜.
Lamarckii presents itself as Egypt's first smart apiary. It uses technology to fight the decline of bees, which threatens the food supply, and it also offers home beehives. Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Ayman Abbas invested in it together.
Sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kQM0eLYZ5Tw https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IXuwYQNsF8M https://sharktankarabi.com/4008/ https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=886021870859592

## HAVANA (هافانا)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/havana-socks/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/havana-socks/
Sector: Fashion
Outcome: deal
HAVANA pitched in Season 4, episode 18. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 50M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ayman Abbas: 5M EGP for 25%.
عرض فريق هافانا مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٨. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٥٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أيمن عباس بقيمة ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜.
HAVANA is an Egyptian sock brand built around bamboo fabric. It makes socks for two groups that need more from everyday hosiery: people with diabetes, who need gentle and breathable socks for sensitive feet, and athletes, who want comfort during training. The brand started with just EGP 15,000 in capital and has since grown to EGP 50M in sales. It sells online through its own website and its social media pages.
Sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MiciW6RGQzs https://sharktankarabi.com/3910/ https://sharktankarabi.com/3956/ https://www.facebook.com/havanasocks.eg/ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WwPw_meEvAY https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=886021617526284

## Chug Up (تشاج أب)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/chug-up/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/chug-up/
Sector: Health
Outcome: deal

## Plume (بلوم)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/plume/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/plume/
Sector: Home
Outcome: deal
Plume pitched in Season 4, episode 17. They walked away with a deal.
عرض فريق بلوم مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٧. انتهى العرض بصفقة.
Plume is an Egyptian sleep brand that brings the five-star hotel bedroom home. It began as a small family workshop and grew into a supplier of bedding to some of Egypt's biggest hotels. It now sells the same hotel-grade mattresses and sleep products straight to households through its online store. Its materials are imported from Germany, from Hanseatic Bedding, a leading hospitality bedding maker, so families can get the hotel experience every night. Its tagline is 'Rest Assured'. The founders held their ground in negotiations and closed a deal.

## Pencilight (بنسلايت)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/pencilight/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/pencilight/
Sector: Home

Pencilight is a Cairo-based decorative lighting brand, founded in 2018, that brings premium, original modern and contemporary designs to Egyptian homes and businesses. One of its pieces won the Cairo Design Award for lighting, and its Cartouche project was a finalist at the Light Middle East Awards 2026.

## Nutrifits (نيوتري فيتس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/nutrifits/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/nutrifits/
Sector: Food
Outcome: deal
Nutrifits pitched in Season 4, episode 12. The founders asked for 15M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 150M EGP. They walked away with a deal.
عرض فريق نيوتري فيتس مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٢. طلب المؤسسون ١٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٥٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة.
Nutrifits is an Egyptian maker of healthy and functional foods that wants to localise the industry and compete with imported health brands. It runs its own factory of about 1,000 square metres with several production lines. The filling lines are Egyptian-made, the jars are produced locally and only the capping systems are imported from China. It sells four health-focused products under one umbrella brand, including Fuel, Gouter and Zero, each aimed at a different group of health-conscious consumers.

## NNO Home (إن إن أو هوم)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/nno-home/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/nno-home/
Sector: Home
Founders: Nehal Osama, Nouran Osama
Outcome: deal
NNO Home pitched in Season 4, episode 12. The founders asked for 2M EGP for 25%, valuing the company at 8M EGP. They walked away with a deal: 2M EGP.
عرض فريق إن إن أو هوم مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٢. طلب المؤسسون ٢ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ٨ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة بقيمة ٢ مليون ج.م.
NNO Home is an Egyptian home-décor brand founded by sisters Nehal and Nouran Osama, and its name comes from their initials. The brand makes eco-friendly pottery that is painted by hand by real artists. Each piece is made to order, so customers get original décor instead of mass-produced items. The founders bring about ten years of interior-styling experience to the brand, and they also champion women's entrepreneurship. The sisters left the tank with the EGP 2 million they asked for.

## Re-Blocks (ري بلوكس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/re-blocks/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/re-blocks/
Sector: Manufacturing
Founders: Ahmed El-Bably, Dina Soliman
Outcome: deal
Re-Blocks pitched in Season 4, episode 12. The founders asked for 1M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 10M EGP. They walked away with a deal: 1M EGP.
عرض فريق ري بلوكس مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٢. طلب المؤسسون ١ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة بقيمة ١ مليون ج.م.
Re-Blocks (Reblox) is an Egyptian architecture studio founded by architects Ahmed El-Bably and Dina Soliman that builds with LEGO-style blocks made entirely from recycled plastic. It tackles the waste of temporary event structures: by the founders' account, around 70% of pop-up booths end up in landfill after two or three days. The system uses just two block designs, a single and a double, that can be assembled, taken apart and rebuilt into completely different structures. In two years Reblox has delivered more than 170 builds, from Cairo Design Week to the RiseUp Summit. The founders left the tank with the EGP 1 million they asked for.

## EISAC Automation (إيزاك أوتوميشن)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/eisac-automation/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/eisac-automation/
Sector: Tech
Founders: Raymond Kamal
Outcome: no deal
EISAC Automation pitched in Season 4, episode 10. The founders asked for 40M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 400M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق إيزاك أوتوميشن مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١٠. طلب المؤسسون ٤٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٤٠٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
EISAC Automation is a Cairo-based industrial-automation partner for factories, founded in 2009 and led by Raymond Kamal. It helps plants keep production lines running by supplying, programming and maintaining PLC, HMI, SCADA and servo systems, repairing industrial electronics, and installing and commissioning machines. Its clients include pharmaceutical, food and plastics manufacturers across Africa, the Middle East and Europe. The company offers Egyptian engineering expertise at roughly a third of the cost of bringing in a foreign expert. It did not get an investment from the sharks.

The Mat Homes is an Egyptian home-decor brand founded by Mohamed Nowair and Farah Alaa that reimagines the humble doormat. ## Think Tree (ثينك تري)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/think-tree/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/think-tree/
Sector: Education
Founders: Ahmed El-Adly
Outcome: deal
Think Tree pitched in Season 4, episode 9. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Ismail Mansour and Dina Ghabbour: 2M EGP for 30%.
عرض فريق ثينك تري مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٩. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد إسماعيل منصور ودينا غبور بقيمة ٢ مليون ج.م مقابل ٣٠٪؜.
ThinkTree is an Egyptian edtech startup, founded in 2024 by Ahmed El-Adly, that teaches chess to children and teens online. It uses the game to build thinking skills and character. Students join live online sessions, either in small groups or one-to-one with a coach. They follow a structured 13-level curriculum taught in Arabic or English, and plans start at about $11 a month. ThinkTree has taught students from Egypt, the UAE, Pakistan, the UK and the US.

## Runners (رانرز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/runners-delivery/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/runners-delivery/
Sector: Services
Founders: Ahmed El-Dabbash
Outcome: deal
Runners pitched in Season 4, episode 9. They walked away with a deal with Abdallah Sallam: 500K EGP for 20%.
عرض فريق رانرز مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٩. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع عبد الله سلام بقيمة ٥٠٠ ألف ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜.
Runners is an Egyptian shipping and delivery app built by Ahmed El-Dabbash, who worked as a delivery courier before becoming a founder. Drawing on that experience, the app tackles one of the trade's most persistent problems: trust over cash. Runners secures the payment flow between couriers and the merchants they deliver for, so both sides know the money from each order is protected. The startup won backing on Shark Tank Egypt Season 4, where Abdallah Sallam invested EGP 500K for a 20% stake.

URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/fino/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/fino/
Sector: Food
Outcome: unconfirmed

Fino is an Egyptian fast-food concept that revives the classic neighbourhood deli, building every sandwich on traditional fino bread baked fresh in-store each day. The team spent eight months perfecting the bread before opening. The local menu covers cheeses, eggs, cold cuts, liver, sujuk, sausage, chicken and potatoes, plus sweet picks such as a sakalans sandwich with jam, tahini and honey. Backed by Tayf Holding, it started in Sheikh Zayed and opened a second branch at C Park Mall in New Cairo.

Somaia Aboelezz is an Egyptian social fashion enterprise making wearable art, with designs inspired by ancient Egyptian dress and the strength and beauty of the goddess Bastet. Goldabikia is an Egyptian lithium-battery venture that gives used batteries a second life. Instead of letting old lithium cells end up as scrap, it collects and repurposes them into clean energy-storage units. ## Tayar (طيار)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/tayar/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/tayar/
Sector: Services
Founders: Abanoub Ramzy
Outcome: no deal
Tayar pitched in Season 4, episode 4. The founders asked for 15M EGP for 8%, valuing the company at 187.5M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق طيار مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٤. طلب المؤسسون ١٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٨٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٨٧٫٥ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Tayar is an Egyptian electric Fleet-as-a-Service platform that supplies electric bikes and riders for last-mile delivery. Delivery apps and couriers need cheap, reliable bikes, and petrol costs eat into riders' earnings. Tayar bundles electric two-wheelers, access to battery-swapping stations, fleet-management software and rider financing, which the company says cuts running costs by 55-82% compared with petrol bikes. It reports more than 900,000 completed orders with partners including Talabat, Amazon and Keeta, and Talabat named it a Top Fleet Partner.

Outcome: no deal
Good Steel Chute Systems pitched in Season 4, episode 4. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق جود ستيل مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٤. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Good Steel is an Egyptian manufacturer of garbage-chute systems for residential buildings. Instead of carrying bags down the stairs or leaving them on landings, residents drop their waste into a chute that runs through the building, so it ends up in one collection point. The aim is a simpler, cleaner and more efficient way for apartment buildings to handle everyday household waste. The company brought this building-infrastructure product to Shark Tank Egypt in Season 4.
Sources: https://www.dostor.org/5285046 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b0iYErmsBmY https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wkpm4pznGEw

## Mystery Bag (ميستري باج)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/mystery-bag/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/mystery-bag/
Sector: Food
Founders: Mohamed Ragab
Outcome: unconfirmed
Mystery Bag pitched in Season 4, episode 3. The founders asked for 1M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 10M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.
عرض فريق ميستري باج مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٣. طلب المؤسسون ١ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٠ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
Mystery Bag is a Cairo food-rescue app that calls itself Egypt's first platform against food waste. Restaurants, hotels, bakeries and grocery shops pack their unsold surplus into surprise 'mystery bags', and nearby customers buy them at about half price. Users browse the bags available in their area, reserve one in the app and pick it up from the store. Bags can hold anything from fresh bakery items to skincare products. Founded in 2024, it was incubated by TIEC and was a 2025 MIT Solve Global Climate Challenge applicant.

## Bayt El Saad (بيت السعد)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/bayt-el-saad/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/bayt-el-saad/
Sector: Home
Founders: Mai El-Ghandour
Outcome: deal
Bayt El Saad pitched in Season 4, episode 3. The founders asked for 6M EGP for 25%, valuing the company at 24M EGP. They walked away with a deal: 6M EGP for 40%.
عرض فريق بيت السعد مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٣. طلب المؤسسون ٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ٢٤ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة بقيمة ٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٤٠٪؜.
Bayt El Saad (also written Beit El Saad) is a Cairo design studio that makes handmade chandeliers, lighting and glassware. It was founded by Mai El-Ghandour, who left a corporate career of more than 20 years to start it. Young Egyptian artisans make every piece using techniques passed down by Old Cairo craftsmen, including hand-blown recycled glass, a craft that only a handful of masters still practise. The designs draw on the sea and on ancient Egyptian heritage, giving homes a contemporary piece with an Egyptian identity and keeping a fading craft alive.

## CarVizita (كار فيزيتا)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/carvizita/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/carvizita/
Sector: Services
Founders: Gamal Badr
Outcome: no deal
CarVizita pitched in Season 4, episode 3. The founders asked for 3M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 30M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق كار فيزيتا مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٣. طلب المؤسسون ٣ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٣٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
CarVizita (also written CarViseta) is an Egyptian mobile car-maintenance service founded by Gamal Badr. Instead of driving to a workshop and waiting there, car owners book a service through the CarVizita app and a technician comes to them. The idea is to save drivers the time and hassle of workshop visits by bringing routine car care to the customer's location. Badr presented the business on Shark Tank Egypt in Season 4.

## Helpoo (هيلبو)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/helpoo/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/helpoo/
Sector: Services
Outcome: no deal
Helpoo pitched in Season 4, episode 2. The founders asked for 40M EGP for 25%, valuing the company at 160M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق هيلبو مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ٢. طلب المؤسسون ٤٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٦٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Helpoo is a Cairo-based roadside-assistance app founded in 2022 and billed as Egypt's first officially licensed provider of smart roadside help, holding a licence from the Financial Regulatory Authority. Drivers request towing, tyre changes, battery boosts or fuel delivery through the app or the 24/7 hotline 17000, see the price upfront based on distance, and follow the camera-equipped rescue truck live on a map. The app also lets users report an accident to their insurer on the spot. In 2023 Saudi mobility platform Morni invested in Helpoo.

## Waymoure (وايمور)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/waymoure/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/waymoure/
Sector: Retail

Waymoure pitched in Season 4, episode 1. The founders asked for 8M EGP for 15%, valuing the company at 53.3M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.

Waymoure is an Egyptian travel-luggage brand built around break-resistant suitcases. It is for travellers tired of bags that crack or fail after a few trips, and every bag comes with a warranty and after-sales service. Founder Omar El-Gabaly wants Waymoure to become the first Egyptian brand of travel bags. The brand reports selling 7,000 bags worth about EGP 13 million in its first five months.

## Khayai (خيّاي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/khayai/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/khayai/
Sector: Sports
Founders: Mohamed Zahran, Nadine Samy
Outcome: deal
Khayai pitched in Season 4, episode 1. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 22.5%, valuing the company at 22.2M EGP. They walked away with a deal: 7M EGP for 50%.
عرض فريق خيّاي مشروعه في الموسم ٤، الحلقة ١. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٢٫٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ٢٢٫٢ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة بقيمة ٧ مليون ج.م مقابل ٥٠٪؜.
Khyal (خيال) is an Egyptian equestrian app founded by Mohamed Zahran and Nadine Samy. The idea began in Saqqara, near the pyramids. Billed as the first app of its kind in the Arab world, it puts riding lessons and free horse riding on one platform. Riders, trainers and stables can connect, users can book sessions, and horses can be bought and sold. The team says it has trained more than 7,000 people and served over 80,000 customers in four years.

## The Nines (ذا ناينز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/the-nines/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/the-nines/
Sector: Fashion
Outcome: no deal
The Nines pitched in Season 4. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق ذا ناينز مشروعه في الموسم ٤. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
The Nines is an Egyptian fashion brand that makes designer luggage covers. Each cover pulls over a suitcase to show off its owner's personality, and it also solves a common travel problem: spotting your own bag among dozens of look-alike suitcases at baggage claim. The brand has built real traction, reporting EGP 14 million in sales from its covers, and pitched on Shark Tank Egypt in Season 4. All the sharks went out, so it left without a deal.

## Gorilla Fits (جوريلا فيتس)

عرض فريق جوريلا فيتس مشروعه في الموسم ٤. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع بيشوي عزمي.
Gorilla Fits is an Egyptian sportswear brand founded by Mohamed Hamad. It was built to compete in a local market where about 85% of sportswear is imported, giving Egyptian athletes and gym-goers a homegrown alternative to foreign labels. The brand has shown real traction, reporting EGP 23 million in sales in a single year. After appearing on Shark Tank Egypt, it brought shark Bishoy Azmy on board as an investor to support its next stage of growth.

URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/didos-snacks/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/didos-snacks/

DIDO's Snacks is an Egyptian snack brand that makes better-for-you biscuits sweetened with fruit sugar and made from natural ingredients. ## Sphinx (سفنكس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/sphinx-safety/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/sphinx-safety/

Sphinx is an Egyptian manufacturer of safety shoes that describes itself as the first company in Egypt to make them entirely locally, from start to finish. Protective footwear is essential for workers on industrial, construction and factory sites, and the Egyptian market has long relied on imported brands. ## Stunning (ستانينج)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/stunning/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/stunning/
Sector: Tech
Founders: Mohamed Ghaith
Outcome: deal
Stunning pitched in Season 4. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 50M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil: 12.5M EGP for 20%.
عرض فريق ستانينج مشروعه في الموسم ٤. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٥٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل بقيمة ١٢٫٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜.
Stunning (stunning.so), founded by Mohamed Ghaith in 2023, is an AI platform that turns an idea described in plain language, spoken or typed, into a website, app or dashboard without code. It generates layouts, images and copy, and adds built-in SEO, AI marketing tools, CRM features and multi-site management for agencies. It natively supports Arabic and right-to-left layouts and serves freelancers, agencies and businesses, with a strong focus on the MENA region. Ghaith came to it after four failed ventures; in the tank the sharks asked how it differs from Google, and the episode and its EGP 12.5M deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil later stirred public debate.

## Jouzoor (جذور)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/jouzoor/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/jouzoor/
Sector: Home
Outcome: unconfirmed
Jouzoor pitched in Season 4. The founders asked for 1.4M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 14M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.
عرض فريق جذور مشروعه في الموسم ٤. طلب المؤسسون ١٫٤ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٤ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
Jouzoor is a contemporary Egyptian craft brand that gives date-palm waste a second life as sustainable bags and home décor. Its designs draw on traditional Egyptian handicrafts, keeping old weaving skills alive while turning an agricultural by-product into modern, everyday pieces. Beyond the products, Jouzoor sets out to empower rural communities economically, and it has already created work for 120 Egyptian women artisans.

## KAK Squad (كاك سكواد)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/kak-squad/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/kak-squad/
Sector: Food
Outcome: unconfirmed

KAK Squad is a fried-chicken and burger fast-food brand with its own integrated factory. Its menu mixes classic fried chicken with Asian-inspired sauces such as Thai chilli, smokehouse, honey and teriyaki, and its signature dip and sauced meals come in 2 to 9 pieces; in 2026 EnterpriseAM's "Eat This Tonight" column named it a top pick for fried chicken in Cairo. It grew from a small restaurant and entered the tank with the goal of making Egyptian fried chicken compete globally. The sharks questioned it about its recipes and the international cooking standards it follows.

## Iron Mist (أيرون ميست)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/iron-mist/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/iron-mist/
Sector: Home
Outcome: deal
Iron Mist pitched in Season 4. The founders asked for 2M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 20M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Abdallah Sallam.
عرض فريق أيرون ميست مشروعه في الموسم ٤. طلب المؤسسون ٢ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٢٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع عبد الله سلام.
Iron Mist (Ironmist) is an Egyptian wrinkle-release spray that smooths clothes in seconds without an iron, and it is safe on all fabrics. It is made for people in a hurry who want neat clothes without setting up an ironing board. You spray the garment, the formula relaxes the creases in the fibres, and then you smooth the fabric by hand. A bottle sells for around EGP 275. After Shark Tank Egypt, the brand launched on Amazon.eg, where it reportedly doubled its sales.

## Amanleek (أمانليك)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/amanleek/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/amanleek/
Sector: Fintech

Amanleek is an online insurance broker that lets customers compare medical and car insurance quotes from different insurers from home in three steps, serving both individuals and businesses. ## UP FUSE (أب فيوز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/upfuse/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/upfuse/
Sector: Fashion

Outcome: deal
UP FUSE pitched in Season 3, episode 19. They walked away with a deal with Ayman Abbas and Noor Sweid.

UP FUSE (Up-Fuse) is a Cairo brand that upcycles waste such as plastic bags, bottles and car tyres into bags, backpacks and fashion pieces, putting environmental awareness at its core. Founded in 2013 by Rana Rafie and Yara Yassin, it works with an NGO in Manshiet Nasser and trains refugee women and mothers, giving them flexible income. It has upcycled millions of plastic bags and bottles, with each backpack using 20–25 bags. The sharks were impressed by the quality and design of its products. On the show it closed a deal with Ayman Abbas and Nour Swid.

## Bubble Store (بابل ستور)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/bubble-store/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/bubble-store/

Outcome: no deal
Bubble Store pitched in Season 3, episode 19. The founders asked for 12M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 120M EGP. They left without a deal.

Bubble Store is an Egyptian retail chain selling eco-friendly cleaning and detergent products through in-store refill machines. Instead of buying a new plastic bottle every time, shoppers bring their own containers and refill them with the product they need. The brand says this saves customers about 40% compared with buying packaged products and cuts down on single-use plastic waste, which makes greener cleaning cheaper for households. ## Raseedi (رصيدي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/raseedi/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/raseedi/
Sector: Fintech
Founders: Ahmed Attallah
Outcome: no deal
Raseedi pitched in Season 3, episode 19. The founders asked for 50M EGP for 5%, valuing the company at 1B EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق رصيدي مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٩. طلب المؤسسون ٥٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ١ مليار ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Raseedi is an Egyptian fintech app that began by helping users save on mobile bundles and grew into instant financing for craftspeople and small businesses. In 2021 it raised an $850,000 pre-Series A round led by Samurai Incubate, with existing investors 500 Global, EFG-EV and Falak Startups. In January 2025 it acquired nano-finance provider Kashat and its subsidiary Pharos Microfinance, adding loans of up to EGP 3,000 for small-business owners, disbursed within five minutes. Founder Ahmed Attallah asked the sharks for EGP 50 million for 5%, a valuation Ahmed El Sewedy said he could not believe. It left the tank without a deal.

## Loop (لوب)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/loop/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/loop/
Sector: Tech
Founders: Moataz El-Wasimy, Mohamed El-Sheikh
Outcome: deal
Loop pitched in Season 3, episode 19. The founders asked for 6M EGP for 20%, valuing the company at 30M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Abdallah Sallam and Mohamed Farouk: 10M EGP for 45%.
عرض فريق لوب مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٩. طلب المؤسسون ٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٣٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع عبد الله سلام ومحمد فاروق بقيمة ١٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٤٥٪؜.
Loop is a platform for launching light-mobility services and e-scooter rentals, adapted to the Egyptian market to fill the gap in short-distance transport. Through the loop Scooter Egypt app, riders sign up with a phone number and unlock shared electric scooters for first- and last-mile trips, with a free trial ride to start. Founders Moataz El-Wasimy and Mohamed El-Sheikh asked for EGP 6 million for 20%. On the show it closed a deal with Abdallah Sallam and Mohamed Farouk for EGP 10 million for 45%.

## Zonta (زونتا)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/zonta/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/zonta/
Sector: Fashion
Founders: Ahmed El Hefny, Sameh Radwan
Outcome: deal
Zonta pitched in Season 3, episode 18. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 50M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk, Abdallah Sallam and Noor Sweid: 5M EGP for 15%.
عرض فريق زونتا مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٨. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٥٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق، عبد الله سلام ونور سويد بقيمة ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٥٪؜.
Zonta is an Egyptian streetwear label whose sneakers, more than 80% made locally, put Arabic front and centre to express Arab identity. Its minimalist Drop 1.0 collection carries words such as Hob (love), Shaghaf (passion) and Fakhr (pride), and it launched on the season finale of Shark Tank Egypt in March 2025. Co-founder Ahmed El Hefny, who started the brand with Sameh Radwan, describes it as a new sub-genre of Arabic sneakers. In the tank he asked for EGP 5 million for 10%.

## 3 DINER (ثري داينر)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/three-diner/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/three-diner/
Sector: Food
Outcome: no deal

Three Diner (3 Diner) is a 100% Egyptian brand of American comfort food from Chef Studios, made with local ingredients. Instead of joining Cairo's crowded burger scene, it serves classic American sandwiches, led by a Philly cheesesteak billed as Egypt's most expensive sandwich. It started as a food truck at The Drive by the Waterway in New Cairo. The menu has grown to include chicken and steak Phillys, loaded fries, a slow-cooked short rib sandwich and a breakfast menu. It left the tank without a deal.

## Cognify (كوجنيفاي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/cognify/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/cognify/

Founders: Ahmed Elmallahy
Outcome: unconfirmed
Cognify pitched in Season 3, episode 17. No public source confirms the outcome yet.

Cognify Education is a Cairo-based inclusive-education startup for children with autism and learning difficulties. Many of these children get little support in mainstream classrooms, so Cognify works with families and schools to make learning more personal. It offers tailored learning programmes, shadow teachers and support staff, nutrition programmes, teacher training and school support systems. It has also signed a partnership with Education For Employment-Egypt to train young people and persons with disabilities.

## Mandisa (مانديسا)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/mandisa/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/mandisa/
Sector: Home
Founders: Mohamed Hebala
Outcome: deal
Mandisa pitched in Season 3, episode 17. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk.
عرض فريق مانديسا مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٧. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق.
Mandisa Naturals is an Egyptian home-living brand that brings Egypt's natural resources to international shoppers, starting with the traditional Egyptian loofah. Founder Mohamed Hebala, who lived in Korea for over nine years, launched it after his Korean wife, who has sensitive skin, found the loofah gentle. Products sourced from Siwa and Sohag, like loofahs, towels and soap, avoid the chlorine bleaching common in the market. The brand sells online, has offices in Egypt and South Korea and a UK representative, and reached its first 2,000 customers in Korea. On the show it closed a deal with Mohamed Farouk.

## Estealamy (استعلامي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/estealamy/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/estealamy/
Sector: Fintech
Outcome: no deal
Estealamy pitched in Season 3, episode 17. The founders asked for 16M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 160M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق استعلامي مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٧. طلب المؤسسون ١٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٦٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Estealamy is an Egyptian fintech startup that helps lenders check loan applicants quickly and reliably. Verifying an applicant's data by hand can slow lending decisions down, so Estealamy uses AI to check applicant information and help financing providers approve loans in as little as 30 minutes. It also delivers field-inquiry reports to lenders through a mobile app and an online dashboard within 24 hours. It turned down offers from Ayman Abbas, Mohamed Farouk and Ahmed Tarek and left without a deal.

## Snugglez (سناجلز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/snugglez/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/snugglez/
Sector: Retail
Outcome: deal
Snugglez pitched in Season 3, episode 17. They walked away with a deal with Ayman Abbas and Ahmed Tarek Khalil.

Snugglez is an Egyptian baby brand that makes wearable sleeping bags for infants and young children. It was started by an Egyptian mother looking for a safer alternative to loose blankets, which babies can kick off or get tangled in during the night. The sleeping bag is worn over the child's sleepwear, so it keeps them warm until morning without loose bedding in the cot. The brand sells online through its own shop and social media pages.

## Hoods (هودز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/hoods/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/hoods/
Sector: Tech
Founders: Mostafa Hanafy, Waleed Ghalwash
Outcome: deal
Hoods pitched in Season 3, episode 16. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 5%, valuing the company at 100M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Mona Ataya: 5M EGP for 15%.

Hoods is a live-shopping app, billed as the first live entertainment-commerce platform in the Middle East, that blends social media and e-commerce and operates in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. Shoppers watch live streams, chat with creators and buy in the app, while sellers run live channels without building their own website, payments or shipping. Founded in Cairo in 2020, it raised a $350,000 pre-seed round and backing from valU. Founder Mostafa Hanafy asked for EGP 5 million for 5% and secured EGP 5 million from Ahmed Tarek and Mona Ataya.

Cleo Foods makes rice-cake snacks as a healthy alternative to bread, adapted to Egyptian tastes. ## SRV (إس آر في)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/srv/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/srv/
Sector: Services
Founders: Mohamed Ayman
Outcome: unconfirmed
SRV pitched in Season 3, episode 15. The founders asked for 10M EGP for 20%, valuing the company at 50M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.
عرض فريق إس آر في مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٥. طلب المؤسسون ١٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٥٠ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
SRV (SRV Spaces) is a B2B procurement platform that covers a company's monthly office and facility needs in a single order. Its catalogue of more than 600 essentials spans hygiene and janitorial supplies, break-room supplies and coffee, stationery, appliances and IT equipment, and it also arranges services such as cleaning and pest control. Companies register, order online and receive deliveries within 24 to 72 hours, with an e-invoice compliant with the Egyptian Tax Authority. SRV says it serves more than 100 active companies, and founder Mohamed Ayman asked the sharks for EGP 10 million for 20%.

## Roufy's (روفيز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/roufys/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/roufys/

Outcome: deal
Roufy's pitched in Season 3, episode 15. The founders asked for 14M EGP for 30%, valuing the company at 46.7M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Abdallah Sallam, Mohamed Farouk and Ahmed Tarek Khalil: 14M EGP for 50%.

Roufy's is a premium American-style burger restaurant in Maadi, Cairo, started by brothers Mohamed and Ibrahim Arafa, who source special cuts and premium ingredients yet price below the market. Diners praise its home-made feel and dishes such as The Melt burger and sandwich, the Shrooms burger, buffalo wings, mac and cheese and mini pancakes. The brothers asked for EGP 14 million for 30%. ## Monster's Table (مونسترز تيبل)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/monsters-table/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/monsters-table/

Founders: Farida, Farah
Outcome: deal
Monster's Table pitched in Season 3, episode 13. The founders asked for 3M EGP for 15%, valuing the company at 20M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Abdallah Sallam: 3M EGP for 30%.

It started as a passion project when co-founder Farah Aly wanted to give her own daughter the healthiest start with wholesome homemade food. Its range covers nutrient-dense purees, finger foods, mini meals and sauces, each matched to a stage of development. Most meals are ready in about five minutes, so busy parents get a quick and nutritious option. A team of eight, including three chefs, delivers across Cairo and has expanded to Sahel. ## Right Temp (رايت تمب)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/right-temp/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/right-temp/
Sector: Services
Founders: Karim Taha
Outcome: unconfirmed
Right Temp pitched in Season 3, episode 13. The founders asked for 4M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 40M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.
عرض فريق رايت تمب مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١٣. طلب المؤسسون ٤ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٤٠ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
Right Temp is an Egyptian cooling-solutions company founded by Karim Taha. It makes containers that hold products such as food at a set temperature without needing any power source, which is useful wherever electricity or refrigeration is unavailable or unreliable. The containers come in several types and sizes to suit different loads and uses. Right Temp brought its passive cooling idea to Shark Tank Egypt in Season 3.

## LAKANTO (لاكانتو)

LAKANTO brings sugar-free sweets to Egypt, sweetened with monk-fruit extract instead of sugar. It is aimed at people who love sweets but want to cut sugar, such as diabetics, keto dieters and health-conscious families. Lakanto is a monk-fruit sweetener brand from Japan's Saraya group, which announced in 2023 that it would make and sell sugar-free chocolate in Egypt. On Shark Tank Egypt Season 3 it asked for EGP 4 million for 10% and left with an investment from Ahmed Tarek.

## Dentolize (دنتولايز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/dentolize/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/dentolize/

Outcome: deal

Dentolize is practice-management software that lets dentists run their clinics through an app while patients book appointments, aiming to raise clinic income and cut costs. It began in 2018 when co-founder Dr. Abdelrahman El Shafiey, a Cairo dentist, grew frustrated juggling patient records; today it offers a mobile app, automated patient reminders, performance analytics and customisable billing, and says it powers about 1,350 clinics. It was one of three season-three health-tech projects the sharks put money into. On the show it closed a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil and Ahmed El Sewedy.

## The Baby Garage (ذا بيبي جراچ)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/the-baby-garage/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/the-baby-garage/
Sector: Retail
Founders: Farah Ahmed
Outcome: deal
The Baby Garage pitched in Season 3, episode 11. The founders asked for 9M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 90M EGP. They walked away with a deal.

The Baby Garage is a marketplace where parents can buy, sell or donate new and used children's gear, aimed at new mothers unsure what to buy or where to buy it. Farah Ahmed launched it in 2015 as a volunteer-run community, and it has grown into a business based in 6th of October City that earns from merchant subscriptions, sales commissions, a discount card and ad campaigns for baby brands. Its "Mompreneur" initiative has helped more than a thousand mothers start reselling from home, and the company says its community counts more than 520,000 mothers. URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/irnova/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/irnova/
Sector: Education
Founders: Mohamed Amer
Outcome: no deal
Irnova pitched in Season 3, episode 11. The founders asked for 15M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 150M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق إيرنوفا مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١١. طلب المؤسسون ١٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٥٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Irnova (stylised LRNOVA) is a Cairo-based edtech startup that uses AI to turn traditional curricula and training materials into engaging, interactive digital content. Schools, universities and training providers often lack the time and budget to film courses, so the web platform produces educational videos and full courses presented by culturally tailored virtual avatars. ## OOAPS (أوبس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/ooaps/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/ooaps/
Sector: Services
Founders: Moamen Ragab
Outcome: unconfirmed
OOAPS pitched in Season 3, episode 11. The founders asked for 7M EGP for 20%, valuing the company at 35M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.
عرض فريق أوبس مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ١١. طلب المؤسسون ٧ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٣٥ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
OOAPS (also written Ooaaps) is an Egyptian digital platform that makes importing and exporting easier for traders and businesses. Cross-border trade in Egypt involves a long chain of paperwork and customs procedures, so the platform breaks the process into seven clear steps and handles customs clearance electronically. Customers can also track their shipments, manage inventory and keep financial records in one place. Founded in 2020 by Moamen Ragab, the company has reported plans for a parcel warehouse at Alexandria Port and a customer base of around 3,000.

## CIPPO (سيبو)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/cippo/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/cippo/
Sector: Education
Founders: Tamer El-Kharrat
Outcome: deal
CIPPO pitched in Season 3, episode 8. The founders asked for 4M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 40M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Yasseen Mansour: 30M EGP for 49%.
عرض فريق سيبو مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ٨. طلب المؤسسون ٤ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٤٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع ياسين منصور بقيمة ٣٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٤٩٪؜.
CIPPO (Child Integrated Psychology Programs Organization) provides academic and psychological support for children wherever they are: at school, at home or at sports clubs. Its services include integration and shadow teachers, online academic sessions, occupational and speech therapy, and behavioural support for neurodivergent children, such as those with autism or ADHD. A shadow teacher typically stays with one child for a full school year, working one-on-one and adapting materials in a mainstream classroom. CIPPO serves children aged roughly 3 to 16, and founder Tamer El-Kharrat asked the sharks for EGP 4 million for 10%.

## DXwand (دي إكس واند)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/dxwand/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/dxwand/
Sector: Tech
Founders: Ahmed Mahmoud, Mahmoud Gomaa
Outcome: no deal
DXwand pitched in Season 3, episode 8. The founders asked for 150M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 1.5B EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق دي إكس واند مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ٨. طلب المؤسسون ١٥٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٫٥ مليار ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
DXwand is an AI company offering Arabic conversational AI and data analytics that helps enterprises and government bodies raise productivity and profits. Its platform automates text and voice conversations across call centres, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, SMS and websites, and understands Arabic and English slang. Co-founded in 2018 by CEO Ahmed Mahmoud and Mahmoud Gomaa and based in Cairo and Dubai, it raised a USD 1 million pre-Series A in 2022 and a USD 4 million Series A led by Shorooq Partners and Algebra Ventures in 2024. Its EGP 150 million ask for 10%, to expand beyond Egypt, was the season's largest; the sharks declined to invest but said they wanted to work with it.

Outcome: no deal

عرض فريق رينايل مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ٨. طلب المؤسسون ١٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٥٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
ReNile is an agritech company offering end-to-end smart-farming systems that use IoT sensors to monitor water, air and soil quality around the clock, send instant alerts about problems and suggest fixes, with remote control and data analytics. Its clients span greenhouses, hydroponics, aquaponics, fish and poultry farms and traditional farms. Founder Hazem El Tawab asked for EGP 15 million for 10% but left without a deal; in 2025 ReNile raised $450,000 and announced plans for a Saudi subsidiary.

## Damj (دامج)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/damj/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/damj/
Sector: Tech
Founders: Hazem Salem
Outcome: unconfirmed
Damj pitched in Season 3, episode 7. The founders asked for 6M EGP for 20%, valuing the company at 30M EGP. No public source confirms the outcome yet.
عرض فريق دامج مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ٧. طلب المؤسسون ٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٣٠ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
Damj (also spelled Damej) is an Egyptian digital accessibility tool that opens websites to people with visual and hearing disabilities. For deaf users, it converts on-screen words and lines into sign-language letters, which founder Hazem Salem says is faster than producing a sign-language video for every page. For blind and low-vision users, its screen reader reads a whole site in Arabic and English. Users can also enlarge fonts, highlight links and dim the screen. Damj was designed with UNDP Egypt and showcased at a national disability event attended by President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi.

## El Fares (الفارس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/el-fares/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/el-fares/
Sector: Agriculture
Outcome: deal
El Fares pitched in Season 3, episode 3. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 15%, valuing the company at 33.3M EGP. They walked away with a deal: 6.3M EGP for 50%.
عرض فريق الفارس مشروعه في الموسم ٣، الحلقة ٣. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ٣٣٫٣ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة بقيمة ٦٫٣ مليون ج.م مقابل ٥٠٪؜.
El Fares for Agricultural Development is an Egyptian agri-biotech business that produces plant seedlings through tissue culture, a lab cloning technique. Farmers often plant stock that carries disease, which cuts yields. El Fares grows plantlets from clean mother plants under sterile conditions and multiplies them in large numbers, so growers get uniform, disease-free seedlings. It also sells to farmers online through a storefront on the Agrikoshk agricultural marketplace.

## Al Ahram (Cookito) (الأهرام لأواني الطهي)

Outcome: deal

Al Ahram is a family-owned cookware manufacturer from Alexandria that has been making pots and pans since 1963. ## Duaya (دواية)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/duaya/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/duaya/
Sector: Health
Founders: Ahmed Fazara
Outcome: deal
Duaya pitched in Season 3, episode 1. The founders asked for 12.5M EGP for 15%, valuing the company at 83.3M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ayman Abbas: 12.5M EGP for 27%.

Duaya is a B2B health-tech marketplace, founded in 2021 by Dr. Ahmed Fazara, that connects more than 500 medical suppliers with over 12,000 pharmacies, clinics, hospitals and labs, helping companies in the sector use technology to fix problems in Egypt's healthcare supply market. It became one of Ayman Abbas's first investments on the show, closing at EGP 12.5 million for 27%. In September 2025 it acquired pharmacy-software provider EXMGO and relaunched it as Duaya Go, giving pharmacies their own branded apps and online stores, and it plans to enter GCC markets in 2026.

## Naseej (نسيج)

Naseej is a family-owned Egyptian home-textiles company that designs, specifies and distributes fabrics, about 95% of them made in Egypt. Founded in 2016 and based in Giza, it supplies fabrics and cushions to homeowners and to hospitality clients such as hotels and cafés, and has exported to Croatia, Oman, Saudi Arabia and Jordan. Its designs offer a modern take on Egyptian décor, mixing tribal motifs, classic shapes and minimalist styling. Founder Mohamed Mardini, grandson of one of Egypt's oldest textile makers, asked the sharks for EGP 18 million for 15%. On the show it closed a deal with Mohamed Farouk for 45%.

## The Maker (ذا ميكر)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/the-maker/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/the-maker/

The Maker is a football talent academy founded by former Egypt striker Ahmed Hossam "Mido" that scouts young players from every governorate and gives those who qualify full scholarships. ## Super Fny (سوبر فني)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/super-fanni/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/super-fanni/
Sector: Services
Founders: Ahmed Anwar, Ehsan Hamdy
Outcome: no deal
Super Fny pitched in Season 2, episode 17. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 5%, valuing the company at 100M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق سوبر فني مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ١٧. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٠٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Super Fny (Super Fny) is an Alexandria-based online platform that upskills vocational-school students and technicians and matches them with suitable jobs. Its programmes cover technical skills, workplace safety, soft skills and entrepreneurship, condensing what would take three years of study into two weeks. Co-founded by CEO Ahmed Anwar and COO Ehsan Hamdy, it raised a seed round from investors including EdVentures and the Academy of Scientific Research and Technology, and plans VR-based curricula for different trades. In the tank, Anwar asked for EGP 5 million and turned down an offer of that amount for 25%.

## Cover Spore (كوفر سبور)

Cover Spore is an Egyptian startup that makes aluminium covers to protect car wheel rims from scratches, kerb damage and everyday wear. The company says it is the first product of its kind made in Egypt. It is aimed at car owners who want to keep their rims in good condition without costly repairs or replacements. ## Flouxo (فلوكسو)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/flouxo/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/flouxo/
Sector: Manufacturing
Founders: Hisham Hany
Outcome: deal
Flouxo pitched in Season 2, episode 14. The founders asked for 6M EGP for 30%, valuing the company at 20M EGP. They walked away with a deal for 50%.
عرض فريق فلوكسو مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ١٤. طلب المؤسسون ٦ مليون ج.م مقابل ٣٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٢٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مقابل ٥٠٪؜.
Flouxo is an Egyptian manufacturer of compressors that unload bulk cement from transport trucks. It describes itself as the first maker of this kind of compressor in Egypt and the Middle East, giving truck operators a local option instead of imported equipment. Its design is meant to spare truck owners the cost of frequent compressor overhauls, which keeps their fleets running for less. Founder Hisham Hany brought the business to Shark Tank Egypt in Season 2. On the show, founder Hisham Hany closed a deal with two sharks for 50% of the company.

## AgriKemet (أجري كيميت)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/agrikemet/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/agrikemet/
Sector: Agriculture
Founders: Nourhan Massoud
Outcome: deal
AgriKemet pitched in Season 2, episode 14. The founders asked for 1M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 10M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk.
عرض فريق أجري كيميت مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ١٤. طلب المؤسسون ١ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٠ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق.
AgriKemet is an Egyptian agri-tech startup founded by Nourhan Massoud that turns agricultural waste into alternatives to chemical fertilisers. It tackles two problems at once: the huge volume of crop residue that is burned or dumped every season, and farmers' heavy reliance on costly chemical inputs. Massoud presents the idea as an answer to a global waste problem, and on Shark Tank Egypt's second season it won offers from every shark in the tank. Mohamed Farouk later called it "one of the best companies we invested in".

## Salhly (صلحلي)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/salhly/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/salhly/
Sector: Services
Founders: Rafeek Mohamed
Outcome: deal
Salhly pitched in Season 2, episode 13. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Ismail Mansour, Mohamed Farouk, Ahmed El Sewedy and Abdallah Sallam: 6M EGP.

Salhly (Sal7lyy) is described as the first home-maintenance company in Upper Egypt, based in Asyut. Its app connects households, as well as businesses such as hotels, clinics and schools, with a network of about 100 vetted technicians for electrical, plumbing, carpentry, air-conditioning and satellite-receiver work. Customers get a free inspection, a fixed price agreed upfront, original spare parts from an in-app store, online payment and a 30-day guarantee. It serves Asyut, Sohag and New Valley, and the Athar Foundation named it the best startup in Upper Egypt.

## Interact (إنتراكت)

Interact (InterAct Labs) is a Giza-based Egyptian hardware startup behind Tact, a compact device that turns any ordinary TV, monitor or projected wall into an interactive touch surface. ## Gammbaz (جامباز)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/gammbaz/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/gammbaz/
Sector: Home
Founders: Alia
Outcome: deal
Gammbaz pitched in Season 2, episode 10. They walked away with a deal: 500K EGP for 25%.
عرض فريق جامباز مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ١٠. انتهى العرض بصفقة بقيمة ٥٠٠ ألف ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜.
Gammbaz is an Egyptian home-fragrance brand that makes scented candles from burn-safe oils. It offers more than 50 scents, and its candles do two jobs: once lit, the melted oil can be used as a moisturiser for the skin. That gives buyers a candle that sets the mood and also takes care of their skin. The brand was founded by Alia, the youngest entrepreneur to pitch in season two of Shark Tank Egypt, and it sells mainly through Instagram and TikTok.

L'Oriental is an Egyptian premium catering company that serves weddings and other special events. It helps couples, families and event hosts who want high-quality food and polished service on their big day, without having to coordinate the kitchen and service themselves. The brand runs under the name L'Oriental Moments on social media and takes bookings online and through WhatsApp. It pitched on Shark Tank Egypt in Season 2, Episode 10.

## Agri Cash (أجري كاش)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/agricash/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/agricash/
Sector: Fintech
Founders: Diaa Youssef, Mostafa El-Sehli
Outcome: deal
Agri Cash pitched in Season 2, episode 8. They walked away with a deal with Mohamed Farouk and Ahmed Tarek Khalil: 15M EGP for 40%.
عرض فريق أجري كاش مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٨. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع محمد فاروق وأحمد طارق خليل بقيمة ١٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٤٠٪؜.
AgriCash is an Egyptian agri-fintech platform that gives farmers interest-free, buy-now-pay-later credit for farm and livestock inputs, with limits of up to EGP 3 million and repayment over up to 12 months. It also offers AI-based agronomic advice and crop insurance, and partnered with Alkheir Microfinance on a 0% seasonal financing product for small farmers. Founded in 2024 by Diaa Youssef and Mostafa El-Sehli, it had more than 1,500 active farmers, 60 suppliers and 750+ products by mid-2025, and raised a round led by Alex Angels. On the show, Diaa drew praise from the sharks, though Ahmed Tarek questioned its supply process and its high valuation. Mohamed Farouk and Ahmed Tarek offered EGP 15 million for 40%, and agreed to Diaa's condition that their stake drop to 30%.

## Creative Wrap (كريتيف راب)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/creative-wrap/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/creative-wrap/

Outcome: no deal

Creative Wrap offers architectural wrapping: instead of replacing kitchens, wardrobes, doors, walls, furniture or lifts, it covers existing surfaces with durable architectural film to renovate interiors faster and with less waste. The brand was founded in Dubai in 2017 and launched in Egypt with a local team and a showroom planned at Mall of Arabia; it has completed more than 13,000 projects across its markets. In the tank the sharks saw it as a distinctive idea, but each had a reservation and all of them dropped out without an offer.

## Rnkl (رنكل)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/rnkl/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/rnkl/
Sector: Home
Founders: Omar Al-Tawansy, Mazen Moussa
Outcome: deal

Rnkl is a homegrown brand founded by architects Omar Al-Tawansy and Mazen Moussa that turns recycled paper into light, foldable origami-style furniture, an eco-minded alternative for the Egyptian market. ## Bar & Jar (بار أند جار)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/bar-and-jar/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/bar-and-jar/

## Simplex (سيمبلكس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/simplex/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/simplex/
Sector: Manufacturing
Founders: Ahmed Shaaban
Outcome: deal
Simplex pitched in Season 2, episode 5. The founders asked for 50M EGP for 6%, valuing the company at 833.3M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil, Mohamed Farouk and Ahmed El Sewedy: 50M EGP for 27.5%.
عرض فريق سيمبلكس مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٥. طلب المؤسسون ٥٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٦٪؜، أي بتقييم ٨٣٣٫٣ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل، محمد فاروق وأحمد السويدي بقيمة ٥٠ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٧٫٥٪؜.
Simplex designs and manufactures computer-controlled (CNC) machines such as routers, plasma cutters, fiber lasers and milling machines. It began as Ahmed Shaaban's graduation project at Minya University and now serves more than 4,500 customers in over 30 countries across Africa, Europe and the Middle East. In 2025 it raised $13 million led by Saudi Arabia's National Industrial Development Centre, and in July 2026 it opened a 40,000 m² second factory in 10th of Ramadan City, lifting capacity to 1,500 machines a year. On Shark Tank, Shaaban asked for EGP 50 million for 6%, then the largest ask the show had seen. Ahmed Tarek, Mohamed Farouk and Ahmed El Sewedy made a joint offer, and the two sides agreed on EGP 50 million for 27.5%. Shaaban later told Enterprise that talks with El Sewedy after the show were not completed because they disagreed on the size of the stake.

URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/super-abla/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/super-abla/

Outcome: unconfirmed

عرض فريق سوبر أبلة مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٤. طلب المؤسسون ١٫٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٠ مليون ج.م. لا يوجد مصدر علني يؤكد نتيجة العرض حتى الآن.
Super Abla is an Arabic-language learning system for children aged 3 to 6, created by Egyptian teacher Israa Saleh, known online as "Super Abla". She simplifies Modern Standard Arabic through songs and stories, adapting to each child's learning style, whether visual, kinesthetic or musical. The approach began with a pupil with Down syndrome, for whom she turned a dry grammar lesson into a story. She has also run a 21-day campaign to build children's reading habits, covered by Al Jazeera, and in the tank Ayman Abbas made her an offer without asking a single question.

## Lelu (ليلو)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/lelu/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/lelu/
Sector: Fashion
Founders: Mina Fayez
Outcome: deal
Lelu pitched in Season 2, episode 4. The founders asked for 1.5M EGP for 10%, valuing the company at 15M EGP. They walked away with a deal.
عرض فريق ليلو مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٤. طلب المؤسسون ١٫٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ١٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ١٥ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة.
Lelu is an Egyptian streetwear label for people who want their clothes to say something different. It began in 2020 as a small shop selling t-shirts inspired by the 80s and 90s, then grew into a full apparel brand known for playful designs and bold statements. Its range includes standout pieces such as Hawaiian shirts and neon sets, aimed at young buyers tired of plain, conventional fashion. Founded by Mina Fayez, the brand has also made cause-led drops, including a hoodie collection in support of Palestine.

## Country House (كونتري هاوس)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/country-house/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/country-house/
Sector: Manufacturing
Founders: Sara Helal
Outcome: deal
Country House pitched in Season 2, episode 4. The founders asked for 1.5M EGP for 20%, valuing the company at 7.5M EGP. They walked away with a deal with Ahmed Tarek Khalil for 50%.
عرض فريق كونتري هاوس مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٤. طلب المؤسسون ١٫٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٠٪؜، أي بتقييم ٧٫٥ مليون ج.م. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع أحمد طارق خليل مقابل ٥٠٪؜.
Country House is an Egyptian maker of chalk-finish paints, founded by Sara Helal. It produces locally made decorative paints designed to rival imported chalk paints, giving Egyptian DIY lovers, furniture upcyclers and decorators a home-grown option for matte, vintage-style finishes. The brand sells through its Instagram presence and reported about EGP 614K in sales in its last year before appearing on Shark Tank Egypt. She accepted Ahmed Tarek's offer for 50% of the company.

## Mobikya (موبيكيا)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/mobikya/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/mobikya/
Sector: Manufacturing
Founders: Ibrahim Abu Gendy, Ahmed Abu Gendy
Outcome: deal
Mobikya pitched in Season 2, episode 3. They walked away with a deal with Dina Ghabbour and Ayman Abbas.
عرض فريق موبيكيا مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٣. انتهى العرض بصفقة مع دينا غبور وأيمن عباس.
Mobikya is a Cairo upcycling studio that turns solid waste into eco-friendly furniture and décor such as poufs, mirrors, armchairs and coffee tables. Its signature material is scrap tyres, bought from mechanics before they are burned, alongside items like washing-machine drums; clients who bring their own scrap pay less. Its name comes from the Egyptian word for junk. Brothers Ibrahim and Ahmed Abu Gendy pitched it as their family's dream and left the tank having accepted an offer. Its deal was a joint investment by Dina Ghabbour and Ayman Abbas.

## Fool Tank (فول تانك)
URL: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/en/fool-tank/ | Arabic: https://sharktank.ahmed-ibrahim.com/ar/fool-tank/
Sector: Food
Founders: Hoda Hosny
Outcome: no deal
Fool Tank pitched in Season 2, episode 3. The founders asked for 5M EGP for 25%, valuing the company at 20M EGP. They left without a deal.
عرض فريق فول تانك مشروعه في الموسم ٢، الحلقة ٣. طلب المؤسسون ٥ مليون ج.م مقابل ٢٥٪؜، أي بتقييم ٢٠ مليون ج.م. غادر الفريق دون صفقة.
Fool Tank (styled Foool Tank) is a Cairo breakfast concept built around foul, serving traditional Egyptian breakfast at the highest quality. It started as a delivery-only kitchen and goes well beyond plain fava beans, with foul sandwiches on three kinds of bread and flavours such as kiri cheese, BBQ, sweet-and-sour and fajita. Founder Hoda Hosny impressed the sharks with her energy and enthusiasm from the moment she entered the tank.
